name: Web Clone
description: Snapshot a live web page — HTML + all CSS/JS/image/font assets — into a self-contained file or a directory bundle, with optional component extraction and framework codegen; --convert re-runs extraction/codegen on a saved snapshot. Adds a /web-clone slash command.
author: cognia-next

browser.reason: The snapshot engine is a Node process reached via a Tauri command; it does not exist in the browser build.

mobile.reason: No sidecar / Tauri command host in the mobile WebView.

headless.reason: The snapshot engine is spawned by the Tauri command host; a headless server has no invoke bridge for it. The agent-facing web_clone tools work there via the sidecar instead.

commands.name: /web-clone
commands.description: Snapshot a web page into the workspace.
